title: Time bound for extracting the second component
statement: For every finite bit string $x$, the finite Turing machine with one work tape and only its second-component flag set halts within $5(|x|+1)$ steps and outputs the second component of the pair decoded from $x$, if decoding succeeds, and the empty string otherwise.
hypotheses_covered: The input is an arbitrary finite bit string $x$
The extractor's first-component flag is false and its second-component flag is true
